# 02 Clean

## Purpose

Clean sample metadata, identify comparison groups, handle missing/duplicate IDs and probe annotations.

## Input / Output

|            | File                    |
|------------|-------------------------|
| **Reads**  | `data/01_dat_load.tsv`  |
| **Writes** | `data/02_dat_clean.tsv` |

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: 02_setup
#| message: false 
library(tidyverse) 
library(here)
library(GEOquery)
library(dplyr)
source(here("R", "99_proj_func.R"))
```

## Load data

```{r}
#| label: 02_load-data 
dat_load <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load.tsv"))
sample_metadata <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_sample_metadata.tsv"))
```

## Initial checks

```{r}
#| label: 02_checks

library(dplyr)
library(GEOquery)

# Keep Tumour and Normal breast samples
sample_metadata_clean <- sample_metadata |>
  filter(tissue_group %in% c("Tumour", "Normal breast"))

# Keep the first two columns and the selected samples
# Put the sample columns in the same order as the metadata
# Rename the probe id column
dat_clean <- dat_load |>
  select(1, 2, all_of(as.character(sample_metadata_clean$sample_id))) |>
  rename(probe_id = ID_REF)

# Check the dimensions of both data frames
dat_clean |> dim()
sample_metadata_clean |> dim()

# Count missing values
dat_clean |> is.na() |> sum()
sample_metadata_clean |> is.na() |> sum()

# Check for duplicated probe IDs and sample IDs
dat_clean |> pull(probe_id) |> anyDuplicated()
sample_metadata_clean |> pull(sample_id) |> anyDuplicated()
dat_clean |> colnames() |> anyDuplicated()

# Download the GPL570 annotation table
gpl570_table <- getGEO("GPL570") |>
  Table()

# Check that the required columns exist
stopifnot("probe_id" %in% names(dat_clean))
stopifnot(all(c("ID", "ENTREZ_GENE_ID") %in% names(gpl570_table)))

# Match each probe to its gene ID and place gene_id second
dat_clean <- dat_clean |>
  mutate(
    gene_id = gpl570_table[["ENTREZ_GENE_ID"]][
      match(as.character(probe_id), gpl570_table[["ID"]])
    ]
  ) |>
  relocate(gene_id, .after = probe_id)

# Check that the sample IDs match in the same order
dat_clean |>
  select(-probe_id, -gene_id) |>
  colnames() |>
  identical(as.character(sample_metadata_clean$sample_id))
```

## Save output

```{r}
#| label: 02_save 
write_tsv(dat_clean, here("data", "02_dat_clean.tsv"))
write_tsv(sample_metadata_clean, here("data", "02_sample_metadata_clean.tsv"))
```
